import re

with open('api_framework.py') as f:
    src = f.read()

old_block = '''class Errors:
    """
    Pre-defined error instances for common API error cases.
    These are created once and reused throughout the application.
    """
    user_not_found = APIError("User not found", code=404)
    invalid_token = APIError("Invalid or expired token", code=401)
    permission_denied = APIError("Permission denied", code=403)
    validation_failed = APIError("Validation failed", code=400)
    rate_limit_exceeded = APIError("Rate limit exceeded", code=429)
    internal_error = APIError("Internal server error", code=500)
    resource_not_found = APIError("Resource not found", code=404)
    duplicate_entry = APIError("Duplicate entry exists", code=409)
'''

new_block = '''class _ErrorsMeta(type):
    """
    Metaclass for Errors.

    Each attribute access creates and returns a NEW APIError instance.
    This is intentional: reusing a single exception instance across many
    `raise` statements causes its __traceback__ to grow without bound
    (each raise links the new traceback to the exception's existing one),
    which pins every frame's locals in memory and leaks memory over time.
    Returning a fresh instance per access keeps error type, message and
    code identical while eliminating the leak.
    """

    def __getattr__(cls, name):
        if name.startswith("_"):
            raise AttributeError(name)
        try:
            message, code = cls._ERROR_DEFINITIONS[name]
        except KeyError:
            raise AttributeError(
                f"{cls.__name__!r} has no error {name!r}"
            ) from None
        return APIError(message, code=code)


class Errors(metaclass=_ErrorsMeta):
    """
    Pre-defined errors for common API error cases.

    Accessing an attribute (e.g. ``Errors.invalid_token``) returns a fresh
    APIError instance with the same message and code as before, so raised
    exceptions never share (and accumulate) traceback state.
    """

    _ERROR_DEFINITIONS = {
        "user_not_found": ("User not found", 404),
        "invalid_token": ("Invalid or expired token", 401),
        "permission_denied": ("Permission denied", 403),
        "validation_failed": ("Validation failed", 400),
        "rate_limit_exceeded": ("Rate limit exceeded", 429),
        "internal_error": ("Internal server error", 500),
        "resource_not_found": ("Resource not found", 404),
        "duplicate_entry": ("Duplicate entry exists", 409),
    }
'''

assert old_block in src, "old Errors block not found"
src = src.replace(old_block, new_block)

with open('api_framework.py', 'w') as f:
    f.write(src)

print("patched OK")

from api_framework import APIError, Errors, Request, run_pipeline

# 1) Check Errors attributes: same type, message, code; fresh instance each access
expected = {
    "user_not_found": ("User not found", 404),
    "invalid_token": ("Invalid or expired token", 401),
    "permission_denied": ("Permission denied", 403),
    "validation_failed": ("Validation failed", 400),
    "rate_limit_exceeded": ("Rate limit exceeded", 429),
    "internal_error": ("Internal server error", 500),
    "resource_not_found": ("Resource not found", 404),
    "duplicate_entry": ("Duplicate entry exists", 409),
}
for name, (msg, code) in expected.items():
    e1 = getattr(Errors, name)
    e2 = getattr(Errors, name)
    assert type(e1) is APIError, name
    assert e1.message == msg, (name, e1.message)
    assert e1.code == code, (name, e1.code)
    assert str(e1) == msg, (name, str(e1))
    assert e1 is not e2, name  # fresh instance each time -> no shared traceback
    assert e1.to_dict() == {"error": msg, "code": code}, name
print("Errors attribute checks: OK")

# 2) End-to-end pipeline checks
cases = [
    (Request(data={"action": "read"}, headers={"Authorization": "Bearer short"}),
     "Invalid or expired token", 401),
    (Request(data={"action": "read"}, headers={}),
     "Invalid or expired token", 401),
    (Request(data={"action": "admin_delete", "target": "system"},
             headers={"Authorization": "Bearer validtoken12345678"}),
     "Permission denied", 403),
    (Request(data={"action": "lookup_user", "user_id": "nonexistent_user"},
             headers={"Authorization": "Bearer validtoken12345678"}),
     "User not found", 404),
    (Request(data={"action": "access_resource", "resource_id": "nonexistent"},
             headers={"Authorization": "Bearer validtoken12345678"}),
     "Resource not found", 404),
    (Request(data={"action": "create_entry", "entry_name": "entry_1"},
             headers={"Authorization": "Bearer validtoken12345678"}),
     "Duplicate entry exists", 409),
    (Request(data={"action": "read"},
             headers={"Authorization": "Bearer validtoken12345678",
                      "X-Request-Count": "150"}),
     "Rate limit exceeded", 429),
]
for req, msg, code in cases:
    resp = run_pipeline(req)
    assert resp.error is not None, (req.data, req.headers)
    assert type(resp.error) is APIError, type(resp.error)
    assert resp.error.message == msg, (resp.error.message, msg)
    assert resp.error.code == code, (resp.error.code, code)
    assert resp.status == code, (resp.status, code)

# success case
resp = run_pipeline(Request(data={"action": "read"},
                            headers={"Authorization": "Bearer validtoken12345678"}))
assert resp.error is None and resp.status == 200, resp.status
print("Pipeline behavior checks: OK")
